news.api module

Token-authenticated article and newsletter REST API.

Every endpoint requires authentication (see REST_FRAMEWORK in settings). Role checks happen in the perform_* hooks so the rules match the HTML views through the shared news.access helpers.

class news.api.ArticleViewSet(**kwargs)[source]

Bases: ModelViewSet

CRUD for articles at /api/articles/.

  • GET list: all approved articles.

  • GET detail: approved articles, own drafts, or drafts an editor oversees.

  • POST: journalists only.

  • PUT/PATCH/DELETE: the author journalist or a scoped editor.

alias of ArticleSerializer

approve(request, pk=None)[source]

POST /api/articles/<id>/approve/: editor approval.

DRF always passes pk to detail actions, so the parameter must stay even though get_object() reads it from self.kwargs.

class news.api.NewsletterViewSet(**kwargs)[source]

Bases: ModelViewSet

CRUD for newsletters at /api/newsletters/.

Any authenticated user can read. Journalists and editors can create; only the author or a scoped editor can change or delete.

class news.api.ApprovalLogView(**kwargs)[source]

Bases: APIView

POST /api/approved/: log an approved article.

This stands in for an external system. The approval service calls it with requests, and it records a receipt for that revision.
